title: SQL Injection Review
summary: Parameter-driven input and backend-style error behavior suggest reviewing this flow for SQL or query-language injection patterns.
operator_questions: Do quote, boolean, or time-based variations change status, length, timing, or backend error behavior?
Does the same endpoint accept the same parameter names in query, form, or JSON bodies?

title: Command Injection Review
summary: User-controlled input reaching backend system functionality should be reviewed for shell or command execution edge cases.
operator_questions: Do shell metacharacters, separators, or time-based payloads alter timing, output, or error behavior?
Is this endpoint expected to call OS commands, network tools, archive utilities, or image processors?

title: JWT / Auth Token Misuse Review
summary: Bearer-style authorization should be reviewed for token audience, role scoping, trust boundaries, and acceptance of malformed or downgraded tokens.
operator_questions: Is the Authorization header a JWT, opaque bearer token, or API key, and does the server enforce audience and role claims?
Do lower-privilege or expired tokens still reach the same object IDs or admin paths?

title: Cache Poisoning / Cache Deception Review
summary: Authentication or personalized content should be reviewed for browser and intermediary cache behavior, especially on GET endpoints.
operator_questions: Does this response contain user-specific data but lack strict cache-control or vary protections?
Can path suffixes, extensions, or header variations cause authenticated content to be cached or served broadly?

title: Business Logic / Workflow Abuse Review
summary: Stateful workflows, numeric actions, or repeated-use operations should be reviewed for sequencing, replay, quantity, and integrity assumptions.
operator_questions: Can the workflow be replayed, skipped, repeated, or reordered without server-side enforcement?
Are quantity, price, state, or approval fields trusted from the client side?
